eps.o: Red and Blue take jobs as babysitters and pet groomers, team up to rescue Blue's teddy bear from a taxi, and help animals sleep tight at the farm.
The friends try on Halloween costumes, work together to clean up leaves, and try to catch a colorful butterfly — then they find some time to unwind!
A tea party attracts an uninvited guest, a sneaky mouse makes mischief on movie night, and Blue and Red buckle up to win a race.
On a snowy Christmas Eve, the friends try to stay up and see Santa Fish. Later on, they hit the pool to stay cool, then bundle up to go ice skating.
A furry dog wants Red and Blue's frisbee, Little Fish needs help moving into a new house, and a snappy clam traps the friends' favorite ball.
